name: Sweet Onion, Potato & Blue Cheese Flatbread with Grape-Arugula Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F). Line 2 large baking sheet pans with foil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ small pkg fresh rosemary
0.68 kg new potatoes
1 ½ lemons
⅓ kg red grapes
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Slide rosemary leaves off sprigs; discard sprigs and mince the leaves. Transfer to a large bowl.

Cut potatoes into ⅛-inch thick slices; add to the bowl with the rosemary along with oil, salt, and pepper. Toss potatoes to coat, then divide between sheet pans and arrange in a single layer. Wipe the bowl clean with a paper towel and reserve for later use.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place potatoes in the oven and bake, rotating the sheet pans halfway through, until fork-tender, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Peel and thinly slice onions into half rings.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onions and salt; cook, stirring frequently, until onions are soft and golden brown, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, zest and juice lemons into the reserved bowl. Add oil, maple syrup, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp pure maple syrup
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Carefully remove cooked potatoes from the sheet pans by lifting the corners of the foil and transferring the whole sheet to a flat surface. (Stack foil layers one on top of the other if counter space is limited.)

Divide flatbreads between sheet pans. Layer with potato slices, onions, and crumbled blue cheese. Place in the oven and cook, rotating the sheet pans halfway through, until flatbreads become golden around the edges, and cheese is melted, 5-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled blue cheese
6 flatbreads or naan

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, slice grapes in half and add to the bowl with the dressing. Add arugula and toss to combine the salad.
Slice flatbreads and divide between plates. Serve with arugula salad on the side and enjoy!
